P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: Wooden slat roof overhead, horizontal fence on one side, building wall on another, and low stone wall define a clear enclosed outdoor room.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Only young trees and a gravel ground cover are visible; no shrub or distinct groundcover layer, so planting lacks lush layered depth.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The space is organized around a central seating group with a low table and two chairs, framed by the pergola and flanked by trees and a bench, creating a clear focal point.
